# Introduction

## Project Overview

Explore infrastructure behind the recent AI boom. 
Use visualization to help wrap our heads around mind-boggling numbers related to:

- Money
- Energy
- Water

::: {.notes}
 - As companies invest heavily in generative AI, the growth of AI is no longer just about software models,  it also depends on data centers, chips, electricity, water, and large-scale capital spending.
 - Our project will visualize how AI-related investment and infrastructure have grown over time, where major data centers are located, and how this growth may affect energy demand and environmental resources.

:::

## Visualization challenges

- Three interconnected, but distinct, dimensions to relate
- The money and financial aspect screams for network and temporal visualizations
- The power and water dimensions are natural for geographic visualizations
- Data sources tend to have one of the dimensions, not multiple
- Where data centers are being built connect to water and energy availability in the region
- Who is building the data center and who the tenants will be connects to the money
